data.one_liner: A Flutter widget to draw customizable dotted lines.
data.what_it_does: Allows you to draw horizontal or vertical dotted lines in Flutter applications. It supports customizing line length, thickness, dash length, colors, gradients, and radius.
use_when: You need to display a custom dotted or dashed line in your UI.
You require gradients, rounded corners, or custom gaps inside a divider line.
avoid_when: You only need a standard solid divider line provided by Flutter natively.
You are displaying hundreds of dotted lines in a large list without testing performance impact with RepaintBoundary.
strengths: Highly customizable dash and gap appearance, including gradients and radii.
Supports performance optimization via an optional RepaintBoundary.
Cross-platform support across Android, iOS, web, macOS, Windows, and Linux.
weaknesses: Can cause performance issues or dropped frames if repainted constantly inside frequently rebuilding widgets unless addRepaintBoundary is enabled.

alternatives.name: dotted_border
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick dotted_border if you need to draw dotted borders around widgets rather than standalone lines.
